title: The Bonesculptor's bin-play permission is built as an activated ability, so it reaches the stack and can be negated
summary: R165 and R168 both say "You may play one unit with no abilities from your bin each deployment" is a standing permission that no one should be able to answer, and both record that the engine builds it as a free bounded activated ability that reaches the stack, where Containment Protocol can negate it. Both left it open ("filed rather than fixed"). The round-1 verifier's probe confirmed it still resolves as an activated item.

title: A RAQ register note still warns that the Wispweaver Nectar Ridge guard may be green for the wrong reason
summary: The RAQ register note on claim 1355633589890584636#1 says the Infernal Wispweaver guard is "green partly for the wrong reason given the Sandstone defect" and should be re-checked when the Sandstone case is fixed. The note on #0 says the Sandstone case was a fixture error and the engine was already right, so the warning is stale or the re-check is still owed. A test-and-register problem, not an engine bug.

title: Two Oorblaks both redirect one combat hit
summary: replaceCombatDamage offers the damage to every holder in turn; with Piercing, the leftover the first Oorblak lets through is redirected again by a second Oorblak. The round-1 verifier's probe: 10 Piercing into two 2/4 Oorblaks, the player loses 2 and both die. Designer: 'replacement effects only apply once in an effect'; R104: a thing can only be replaced once. Expected: one Oorblak absorbs 4, the player loses 6. Same defect as F-U12-1 (there with a Blightsea Polyp); merge when ticketing.
